wc:minerva-switch.summary: On / off switch (slider, side labels or segmented).
wc:minerva-switch.description: Toggles between two mutually exclusive states (`<Switch>` of React): a native checkbox with `role="switch"` (Space and Enter toggle it). `off-label` + `on-label` add clickable labels on both sides of the slider, or build a two-segment control with `variant="segmented"`. Form-associated like a checkbox: when on, submits `value` (default `"on"`) under `name`; `required` makes it invalid until on (`valueMissing`); supports `form.reset()` (restores the `checked` attribute), `<fieldset disabled>` and state restoration.

SwitchProps.color: Semantic color of the "on" state (checked thumb and track, active side label / segment)
SwitchProps.shape: Shape of the track and thumb
SwitchProps.label: Label displayed next to the switch
SwitchProps.aria-label: Accessible label, required when the switch has no visible label
SwitchProps.name: Name of the input, used in forms
SwitchProps.labelPlacement: Position of the label relative to the switch
SwitchProps.loading: Shows a loading state and blocks interaction
SwitchProps.ripple: Shows a ripple effect on click
SwitchProps.style: Inline styles of the root element
SwitchProps.onFocus: Called when the switch receives focus
SwitchProps.onBlur: Called when the switch loses focus
SwitchProps.iconPlacement: Icon position: inside the thumb ("start") or after the switch ("end")
SwitchProps.ref: Ref to the underlying <input role="switch"> element
SwitchProps.variant: "slider" is the classic track + thumb; "segmented" renders two pressable segments (requires offLabel and onLabel)
SwitchProps.children: Label content (alternative to label; used when label is not set)
SwitchProps.offLabel: Label of the "off" state; with onLabel, rendered as side buttons or as segments
SwitchProps.id: id of the input (defaults to the enclosing FormControl's id)
SwitchProps.value: Value submitted with the form when on
SwitchProps.aria-labelledby: id(s) of the element(s) labelling the switch (the segment group for the segmented variant)
SwitchProps.aria-describedby: Extra ids of elements describing the switch (the segment group for the segmented variant) (merged with the helper / error text)

cssVars.--switch-thumb-size: Width and height of the thumb (every size)
cssVars.--switch-checked-color: Accent of the checked thumb, track and active segment (defaults to the color prop's accent)
cssVars.--switch-label-gap: Space between the switch and its label
cssVars.--switch-label-font-size: Font size of the label (every size)
